name: rfq-insight
description: Analyze RFQs and automatically convert them into a standardized opportunity description document

interface.shortDescription: Analyze RFQs and automatically convert them into a standardized opportunity description document
interface.longDescription: RFQ Insight transforms RFQ documents into a standardized PowerPoint summary, providing a clear overview of scope, deliverables, timelines, and risks. Interactive follow-up questions and revision comparisons help you to quickly identify key changes and focus on what matters most. The resulting summary is designed to be the basis for efficient and effective opportunity development.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $rfq-insight to analyse the RFQ package in this folder and return only the PowerPoint.
